capabilities: display correction options for misspelled words
apply a correction in one click
save words to a personal dictionary
extras: Alpha version: does not work correctly in Live Preview mode, English text only, and the author warns bugs could delete note data and recommends backups; planned features include a dialect setting and a plagiarism checker.
